== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added from [https://web.archive.org/web/20080906211140/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=94 Policy of virtualizing] (15 August 2008): the August 2006 discussion with the Design Team and Jim Colson, the Virtualization Market Guide (v2.0, 15 August 2006) and its use from Virtual Set 16; and from [https://web.archive.org/web/20081009225918/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/news.php?id=7 10 Questions with Scott Lingrell] (8 October 2008): Lingrell's credit to "Mike Bahr". Both name him Michael Bahr / Mike Bahr; taken as the same person as the 2006 PC Volunteer Award concept credit.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Scott Lingrell's introduction calls the guide's list the "Top 35", while the excerpt of the guide itself is headed "Top 25 cards which should never be virtualized". The article says only "a list of the top cards".
